name: @hobo/provider-neon
description: HoBo Neon Claimable Postgres provider: the data-only neon.claimable-postgres/v1 product definition (data.postgres/v1 native, therefore data.relational/v1 by refinement), an injected-transport REST driver for the unauthenticated neon.new claimable-database API, provider-reported expiry, resource-scoped claim with a blocking post-claim credential rotation ceremony, and pg_dump/pg_restore plus logical-copy migration behind an injected ProcessRunner.
